tokens.iast: atha śāmbhavaśāsanoditāṃ sarahasyāṃ śṛṇutāntyasaṃskriyām // 1b sarveṣāmadharasthānāṃ gurvantānāmapi sphuṭam / śaktipātātpurāproktātkuryādantyeṣṭidīkṣaṇam ūrdhvaśāsanagānāṃ ca samayopahatātmanām / antyeṣṭidīkṣā kartavyā guruṇā tattvavedinā samayācāradoṣeṣu pramādātskhalitasya hi / antyeṣṭidīkṣā kāryeti śrīdīkṣottaraśāsane yatkiṃcitkathitaṃ pūrvaṃ mṛtoddhārābhidhe vidhau / pratimāyāṃ tadevātra sarvaṃ śavatanau caret śrīsiddhātantrakathito vidhireṣa nirūpyate / antimaṃ yadbhavetpūrvaṃ tatkṛtvāntimamādimam saṃhṛtyaikaikamiṣṭiryā sāntyeṣṭirdvitayī matā / pūjādhyānajapāpluṣṭasamaye natu sādhake piṇḍapātādayaṃ muktaḥ khecaro vā bhavetpriye / ācārye tattvasaṃpanne yatra tatra mṛte sati

tokens.iast: antyeṣṭirnaiva vidyeta śuddhacetasyamūrdhani / mantrayogādibhirye ca māritā narake tu te kāryā teṣāmihāntyeṣṭirguruṇātikṛpālunā / na maṇḍalādikaṃ tvatra bhavecchamāśānike vidhau kecittadapi kartavyamūcire pretasadmani / pūjayitvā vibhuṃ sarvaṃ nyāsaṃ pūrvavadācaret saṃhārakramayogena caraṇānmūrdhapaścimam / tathaiva bodhayedenaṃ kriyājñānasamādhibhiḥ bindunā rodhayettattvaṃ śaktibījena vedhayet / ghaṭṭayennādadeśe tu triśūlena tu tāḍayet suṣumnāntargatenaiva visargeṇa punaḥ punaḥ / tāḍayeta kalāḥ sarvāḥ kampate@sau tataḥ paśuḥ utkṣipedvāmahastaṃ vā tatastaṃ yojayetpare / pratyayena vinā mokṣo hyaśraddheyo vimohitaiḥ tadarthametaduditaṃ natu mokṣopayogyadaḥ / ityūce parameśaḥ śrīkulagahvaraśāsane
